scope: All published movie/show trope arrays and detailed trope table; SELECT-only catalog inventory.
counting: Exact names preserved. Occurrences count array entries; title_count deduplicates repeated same-name entries within a title. Example title is lexicographically first and is not paired with an inferred ID.
queries: SELECT count(*) AS catalog_titles,count(tropes) AS titles_with_nonnull_trope_array,sum(array_length(tropes,1)) AS array_associations FROM movie

SELECT name,count(*) AS occurrences,count(DISTINCT tmdb_id) AS title_count,min(title) AS example_title FROM (SELECT unnest(tropes) AS name,tmdb_id,title FROM movie WHERE tropes IS NOT NULL) t GROUP BY name ORDER BY occurrences DESC,name ASC LIMIT 1000000
SELECT count(*) AS catalog_titles,count(tropes) AS titles_with_nonnull_trope_array,sum(array_length(tropes,1)) AS array_associations FROM show

SELECT name,count(*) AS occurrences,count(DISTINCT tmdb_id) AS title_count,min(title) AS example_title FROM (SELECT unnest(tropes) AS name,tmdb_id,title FROM show WHERE tropes IS NOT NULL) t GROUP BY name ORDER BY occurrences DESC,name ASC LIMIT 1000000

SELECT url,count(*) AS associations,sum(CASE WHEN media_type='movie' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS movie_associations,sum(CASE WHEN media_type='show' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS show_associations FROM trope GROUP BY url ORDER BY associations DESC,url ASC LIMIT 1000000
